decisions.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not support a diagnosis of juvenile xanthogranuloma.
The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not support a diagnosis of Rosai-Dorfman disease.

option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not support a diagnosis of juvenile xanthogranuloma.
The clinical presentation and histopathological findings do not support a diagnosis of Rosai-Dorfman disease.

The clinical presentation and histopathological findings, including the presence of osteolytic lesions and a subepidermal infiltrate consisting of large cells with kidney-shaped nuclei, are consistent with multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
Langerhans cell histiocytosis is a broader term that encompasses multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
